name: Client programs fixture
description: The guided checks' fixture for Kiln programs in a client's client world and prediction storage (package 14, mods/tests/client-pass Dev28ClientWorldPrograms.cs): it binds its own client, both and prediction declarations in the main menu, counts their calls per client world, writes a summary line to kiln.log every 600 client steps, and draws a target the pass names 1 m higher in this player's game only. Add it to the profile for the checks that ask for it; the baseline check asks for it to be off.
